course: Multi-Agent Systems from First Principles - Part II

learning.objective: Introduce a second LLM Worker only after one is understood.
learning.previous_architecture: One local reasoning worker is not enough for broader work.
learning.new_question: How does a second reasoning worker change ownership?
learning.result_observed: A second Worker Agent can own a separate local reasoning domain without making the Orchestrator intelligent.

events.label: multi-worker assignment
events.detail: Assign Maze A to Worker Agent A and Maze B to Worker Agent B. Each Worker owns its own maze tools, local memory, and synchronization decisions.

events.label: coordination boundary
events.detail: The Analyst does not choose step-by-step moves for either maze, and the deterministic Orchestrator only dispatches assignments.

events.label: dispatch Maze A

events.label: assign Maze B

events.label: worker sync policy
events.detail: Promote assignment acceptance, route viability, blocked state, and completion; retain routine visited-cell and rejected-move notes locally.

events.detail: Phase 7 has three reasoning agents: Analyst plus two independent Worker Agents, each with its own maze, local memory, tools, and sync decisions.

role_outputs.headline: Analyst assigns independent local reasoning ownership to two Worker Agents.
role_outputs.multi_worker_assignment: Assign Maze A to Worker Agent A and Maze B to Worker Agent B. Each Worker owns its own maze tools, local memory, and synchronization decisions.
role_outputs.coordination_boundary: The Analyst does not choose step-by-step moves for either maze, and the deterministic Orchestrator only dispatches assignments.

role_outputs.headline: Worker Agent A owns local reasoning for Maze A.
role_outputs.local_ownership: Use Maze A tools, private local memory, and synchronization decisions for Maze A only.
role_outputs.sync_policy: Promote assignment acceptance, route viability, blocked state, and completion; retain routine visited-cell and rejected-move notes locally.

role_outputs.headline: Worker Agent B owns local reasoning for Maze B.
role_outputs.local_ownership: Use Maze B tools, private local memory, and synchronization decisions for Maze B only.
role_outputs.sync_policy: Promote assignment acceptance, route viability, blocked state, and completion; retain routine visited-cell and rejected-move notes locally.

role_outputs.headline: Dispatches two assignments without reasoning.
role_outputs.coordination_boundary: No route planning, no local memory access, no LLM call.

role_outputs.headline: Receives promoted discoveries from both Worker Agents.
role_outputs.sync_policy: Store assignments, promoted checkpoints, and completion summaries for Maze A and Maze B.

summary.local_planning_owner: Worker Agent A and Worker Agent B
summary.synchronization_owner: each Worker Agent under Analyst policy
summary.next_phase: Move one Worker Agent into its own hosted boundary after the MazeTool program interface is stable.
